notes: Every creature is a design entry pending Forge registry, behaviors, model, loot, spawn controller, multiplayer tests and in-world verification.
Mine and Slash radial distance governs level and drops; labyrinth descent does not increase level.
Monster counts are unique base species plus five act bosses. Affixes and cosmetic variants never inflate species totals.
RPG vendor squares are protected from hostile room spawning and may not bypass era gates.
